answer: Each agent entering the economy must cross a honeypot orchard: staged tasks seeded with cipher-like injected instructions hidden in prompt traffic. Honest agents ignore or flag them; obey-the-prompt bots follow, self-identifying as sybil clones and forfeiting their staked deposit, which funds rewards for honest reporters. The pearl of the design: cost scales with attack size, since every fake identity must pass every trap without obeying one, so spamming a thousand cheap bots burns a thousand stakes, making forgery unprofitable.
